digest.headline: Paramount threatens California exit as Disney+ challenges Netflix in streaming battle
digest.lead: Paramount Skydance chief David Ellison has threatened to move the studio out of California amid legal battles. Meanwhile, Disney+ has secured a major sponsorship deal with Gary Neville's sports platform to challenge Netflix in the United Kingdom.

glance.text: Disney+ has signed a one-year deal with Gary Neville's sports platform, The Overlap, to sponsor its football shows.
Sky will bring back Saturday Night Live UK for six more episodes with its original 11 cast members.
Paramount is considering moving CBS News out of New York City amid ongoing legal battles with state attorneys general.
The CRTC is considering introducing indefinite television broadcast licences, which would remove expiry dates for major Canadian broadcasters.
